algorithms.title: Nerve Agent Casualty
steps: PPE; remove from source; disrobe/decon (vapor: clothing removal; liquid: wet decon).
Assess severity: mild (miosis, rhinorrhea), moderate (secretions, wheeze, vomiting, fasciculations), severe (resp. distress, seizures, unconscious, apnea).
Mild: observe; 1 kit if symptoms progress. Moderate: 1 kit (atropine 2.1 mg + pralidoxime 600 mg IM).
Severe: 3 kits rapidly + benzodiazepine (midazolam 10 mg IM or diazepam 10 mg) for seizures.
Support ventilation; suction secretions (atropine first makes BVM ventilation possible).
Repeat atropine 2 mg every 5–10 min until secretions dry and breathing is easy.
Children: weight-based atropine/pediatric auto-injectors per protocol.

algorithms.title: Cyanide (incl. Smoke Inhalation)
steps: Remove from source; decon if liquid exposure.
Suspect if: enclosed-space fire + AMS, hypotension, seizures, or arrest; sudden collapse near HCN source.
Hydroxocobalamin 5 g IV/IO over ~15 min (child 70 mg/kg); repeat once if needed.
Expect red skin/urine; SpO2 and some labs may read falsely.
Avoid nitrites if CO poisoning is possible.
